No barrel file re-exports `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`, so every importer names the module path directly. I'm checking the last candidates now.

I found 10 files that import from `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`. Nine import only `consumeRateLimit`:
- **Server actions:** `login`, `reset-password`, `create-comment`, `invite-member`
- **API route:** `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts`
- **Server services:** search, invitation, comment and auth

The tenth, `tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts`, is the only file that imports anything else. It pulls in `RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS`, `getBucketConfig`, `resetRateLimits` and `setOrgPlan`.

I left out these files because none of them imports from the module:
- **Mocks:** `tests/server/plan-limits.test.ts` and `tests/services/{search,comment,invitation}-service.test.ts` replace the module with `vi.mock("@/lib/rate-limit", ...)`.
- **Stand-in module:** `tests/server/_support/doubles/misc.ts` supplies the replacement those mocks use.
- **Comments only:** `src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts` and `src/server/db/schema/webhooks.ts` mention the module in comments.
- **Name strings only:** the manifest scripts under `scripts/` list its export names as strings.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/auth-service.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, src/actions/auth/login.ts, src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts, src/actions/members/invite-member.ts, tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts
